monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral dehumidifier decision and acceptance-test system covering measured moisture load, capacity conditions, efficiency, drainage, operating range, electrical fit, recalls, returns, and first-year cost. No merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, paid placement, or generic product link was added; correcting the moisture source, using supported existing equipment, or buying nothing remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: The three new pages and Arkansas supporting expansion use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. The Cherry Blonde page explicitly withholds a cultivar photo because no exact licensed image was verified. No patient, cannabis product, PAP device, dehumidifier, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is one day old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. The Arkansas legal page had six impressions, one click, 16.7% CTR, and average position 9.667—the only page-level signal with more than a token sample in the target 4–20 band—so the analytics-led action preserves that established URL and adds current patient, renewal, caregiver, visiting-patient, dispensary, and primary-source workflows rather than creating a cannibalizing page. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12 but already maps to an existing page; Delaware had two impressions and one click; Blue Dream had 33 impressions near position 48; single-impression legal and health rows were too weak. Those signals were deliberately ignored as duplicative, tiny, or out of range. None of the three new pages is presented as primarily Data-led.

authority.action: Published two citation-worthy evidence assets: a sleep-apnea outcome translator with a study-transfer screen and clinician handoff, and a Cherry Blonde CBD field note that separates a commercial breeder record from an independent University of Vermont trial and the finished-lot evidence chain. Reciprocal links strengthen the sleep, next-day impairment, CBD-hemp, CoA, product-complaint, and named-cultivar clusters. The Arkansas page also adds a primary-source role map. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent.
